item.title: Man, 31, dies after he’s shot in head outside Queens laundromat
item.description: The 31-year-old victim was shot right outside the Super Laundry Laundromat at the Conduit Plaza shopping strip around 8:37 a.m. near Springfield Blvd. and 144th Ave. in Laurelton.

item.title: NJ man repeatedly stabs woman, tells concerned neighbor: ‘It’s not a good time’
item.description: A New Jersey man is accused of repeatedly stabbing a woman, then telling a concerned neighbor that it's "not a good time" when they went to check on her.

item.title: Daily Horoscope for February 15, 2026
item.description: A fresh, wide view could be hard to handle today. With the emotional Moon entering Aquarius at 1:17 am EST, we may feel pulled toward community conversations that spark inventive ideas and build kinder bonds. That said, changing the status quo often requires letting go of dynamics we find comfortable. When Luna conjoins intense Pluto, our feelings about such shifts might burst out in unpleasant ways! There’s more to life than logic, but overwrought emotions are likely to pass if we let them.

item.title: Suspect, 17, arrested in Bronx triple shooting that killed 16-year-old
item.description: The 17-year-old suspect was charged with murder, attempted murder, manslaughter and criminal weapon possession in connection with the triple shooting that killed Christopher Redding and injured two others on W. 238th St. in Kingsbridge.

item.title: Obama speaks out on Trump’s racist ape post, rips social media ‘clown show’
item.description: Barack Obama finally spoke out on the racist video posted by President Trump, dismissing it as part of a "clown show" playing out on social media.

item.title: Jack Eichel and Brady Tkachuk power the U.S. past Denmark 6-3 at the Olympics
item.description: The U.S. rode its top line to a 6-3 defeat of Denmark on Saturday night, keeping pace with also-unbeaten Canada for the top seed in the men's hockey tournament.

item.title: Crooks swipe $30K in jewelry from Hudson Yards luxe boutique
item.description: The diamond-hunting duo targeted the Monica Rich Kosann jewelry store in The Shops, inside 20 Hudson Yards, near W. 30th St. and 10th Ave., on Feb. 5.

item.title: Heat’s Keshad Johnson soars to a slam dunk title, edging Carter Bryant who had a perfect score
item.description: Keshad Johnson of the Miami Heat won the Slam Dunk contest at NBA All-Star Saturday.
